data.headline: AHT sells Philadelphia hotel for approximately $26.0 million

claims.text: AHT completed the sale of the Embassy Suites Philadelphia Hotel on October 6, 2026.

citation.quote: On October 6, 2026, Ashford Philly LP, an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Ashford Hospitality Trust, Inc. (the “Company”), completed the sale of the Embassy Suites Philadelphia Hotel located in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania

claims.text: The sale was for approximately $26.0 million in cash, subject to customary pro-rations and adjustments.

citation.quote: for approximately $26.0 million in cash, subject to customary pro-rations and adjustments.

claims.text: The prior quarterly balance sheet reported liabilities related to assets held for sale of 74,813 at June 30, 2026, versus 41,292 at December 31, 2025.

citation.quote: Liabilities related to assets held for sale | 74,813 | 41,292
